up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values for the human target CHEMBL1787 (3-oxo-5-alpha-steroid 4-dehydrogenase 1), which is a single protein target. Only include rows where the standard relation is exactly '='. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from assays table), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (pchembl_value from activities). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1787' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
